The woman behind the scroll.

She's a woman navigating everyday life, trying to take care of herself, make good choices, and find little ways to enjoy her life again.

She's interested in

  • Skincare that makes sense for her skin and budget
  • Products that make motherhood and everyday life a little easier
  • Realistic routines rather than picture-perfect lifestyles
  • Recommendations from someone who feels like a friend, not a salesperson

What she responds to

Honest experiences, relatable storytelling, useful education, and products shown in real-life situations.

What she doesn't need more of

Overly polished ads, unrealistic promises, and content that feels like someone is desperately trying to sell her something.

I want people to see themselves in the story before they see the product in it.
